title: Lowe's launches spring deals and free same-day mulch delivery for loyalty members - North Raleigh Today
text:
Lowe’s announced on March 25 the start of its spring home improvement season, offering new promotions, loyalty perks, and project support for homeowners and professionals. The retailer will begin rolling out multiple spring deals events from March 26, with seasonal promotions and limited-time benefits for MyLowe’s Rewards and MyLowe’s Pro Rewards members.
The announcement comes as demand increases for lawn, garden, patio, and project essentials with the arrival of warmer weather. Lowe’s aims to provide value and flexibility to customers preparing their homes for the coming months by pairing extended savings with loyalty rewards and convenient delivery options.
For the first time, MyLowe’s Rewards and MyLowe’s Pro Rewards members can access free same-day delivery on eligible orders over $25, including mulch. Jen Wilson, chief marketing officer at Lowe’s said: “Spring is one of the most energizing times of year for homeowners, and you can feel that momentum the moment you walk into Lowe’s. When customers are ready to start their seasonal projects, they’ll find inspiration in our aisles and expertise from our red-vest associates. That is what sets Lowe’s apart year-round, and why – especially when spring arrives – there is no place like Lowe’s.”
The SpringFest event runs from March 26 through April 22 with deals across categories such as lawn & garden supplies (including Sta-Green mulch), outdoor power equipment (featuring EGO products), appliances (with up to 40% off select items), paint supplies from Sherwin-Williams brands, grills by Weber or Char-Broil, as well as exclusive member offers like giveaways or workshops for children. During Mulch Week (April 9–15), all customers can purchase five bags of Sta-Green Mulch for $10 while loyalty members earn five times points on eligible purchases.
Bill Boltz, executive vice president of merchandising at Lowe’s said: “Vendors are bringing Lowe’s their best products first… With exclusive brands, innovative products and great value across every category, there’s never been a better lineup at Lowe’s.” Exclusive products this season include those from Scotts fertilizer company; Bonnie Plants; EGO power tools; Toro mowers; Weber grills; Char-Broil cookers; Daltile tile designs; allen + roth furniture collections; Origin21 décor items plus private labels like Kobalt tools or Style Selections furnishings.
All stores will be closed on Easter Sunday (April 5) but online-only savings will be available that day. Customers can shop in-store or online using buy-online-pick-up-in-store services or same-day/on-demand delivery via Lowes.com or third-party partners.
